sents.en: Once upon a time, there was a mother duck.
sents.cn: 从前，有一只鸭妈妈。

sents.en: She had six little ducklings.
sents.cn: 她孵出了六只小鸭子。

sents.en: Five of the ducklings were small and yellow, but the last duckling was big and grey.
sents.cn: 五只小鸭子又小又黄，可最后一只又大又灰。

sents.en: "He doesn't look like us!"
sents.cn: “他长得跟我们不一样！”

sents.en: "What an ugly duckling!" the other ducklings said.
sents.cn: “多丑的小鸭子啊！”其他小鸭子说。

sents.en: "That's not nice!" said Mother Duck.
sents.cn: “这话可不好听！”鸭妈妈说。

sents.en: "He's still a duck like us!"
sents.cn: “他跟我们一样，也是只鸭子！”

sents.en: In the river, the ugly duckling swam well, just like all the other ducklings.
sents.cn: 在河里，丑小鸭游得很好，跟其他小鸭子一样。

sents.en: But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away.
sents.cn: 可其他小鸭子还是嘲笑他，还让他走开。

sents.en: It made the poor duckling very sad, so he decided to search for a new home.
sents.cn: 这让可怜的丑小鸭很难过，于是他决定去找一个新家。

sents.en: He met many other birds, but all of them thought that he was ugly too.
sents.cn: 他遇到很多别的鸟，可它们都觉得他也丑。

sents.en: They did not want him to live with them.
sents.cn: 它们不愿让他和自己住在一起。

sents.en: One day, the duckling met a cat and a hen.
sents.cn: 一天，小鸭子遇到一只猫和一只母鸡。

sents.en: "May I stay with you?" he asked hopefully.
sents.cn: “我可以和你们住在一起吗？”他满怀希望地问。

sents.en: But the two animals said no.
sents.cn: 可那两只动物说不行。

sents.en: They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!
sents.cn: 它们不喜欢他，因为他既不会打呼噜，也不会下蛋。

sents.en: Some days later, the ugly duckling came to a lake.
sents.cn: 几天后，丑小鸭来到一个湖边。

sents.en: There, he saw three beautiful swans with long necks and white feathers.
sents.cn: 在那里，他看到三只美丽的天鹅，脖子长长的，羽毛雪白。

sents.en: "I wish I looked like you!" he cried.
sents.cn: “我真希望自己长得像你们一样！”他喊道。

sents.en: "My friend, you do look like us!"
sents.cn: “朋友，你确实长得和我们一样！”

sents.en: "Look in the water!" one of the swans said.
sents.cn: “看看水里！”其中一只天鹅说。

sents.en: The duckling looked down, and to his surprise, he saw that he was a beautiful white swan too.
sents.cn: 小鸭子低头一看，让他吃惊的是，他发现自己也是一只美丽的白天鹅。

sents.en: Once upon a time, a fisherman caught a bottle in his fishing net.
sents.cn: 从前，一个渔夫在渔网里捞到一个瓶子。

sents.en: When he opened it, a great cloud came out and became a genie.
sents.cn: 他打开瓶子，一团巨大的烟雾冒出来，变成了一个精灵。

sents.en: "Prepare to die!" shouted the genie.
sents.cn: “准备受死吧！”精灵喊道。

sents.en: "A long time ago, I made a promise.
sents.cn: “很久以前，我许下过一个诺言。

sents.en: If someone set me free, I would make them rich and powerful.
sents.cn: 谁要是放我出来，我就让他又有钱又有势。

sents.en: But no one ever came.
sents.cn: 可一直没有人来。

sents.en: After years and years of waiting, I became very angry.
sents.cn: 年复一年地等，我变得非常愤怒。

sents.en: If anyone set me free, I would kill them instead of giving them anything.
sents.cn: 现在谁放我出来，我就杀了他，什么也不给。

sents.en: So, you must die!"
sents.cn: 所以，你必须死！”
